previous_versions.body: For 12.3.6, we often need to load javascript from different domains in browser-based apps for page load performance. Sub-resource Integrity can help this be done safely. So if we don't have it already, I'd suggest we add it as an exception for 12.3.6 - as is 12.3.6 is too strict.

And just so we keep some of this I suggest we modify 10.6.2 a little to include transitive dependencies.
